selection_rationale: Highest relevance to the programme goal (operational correctness of LLM-driven NetOps), strong falsifiability and statistical design, feasible within compute budget, and reviewed as acceptable ('pass') after addressing listed methodological risks.
unresolved_uncertainties: Simulator fidelity vs real vendor runtime behavior and the degree to which simulator labels reflect production correctness (related to Q1).
Degree to which deterministic verifier completeness varies by vendor/template and confounds method comparisons.
Robustness of generate→verify→repair improvements under adversarial retrievals or prompt-injection (related to Q2).
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Validate simulator/emulator fidelity on a small set of vendor reference configurations and document known gaps and limitations.
Specify verifier capabilities, checks, and known limitations per vendor/template; publish verifier detection taxonomy to accompany the experiment.
Sanitize vendor configuration templates for licensing/privacy, document provenance, and either expand vendor diversity or justify vendor selection.
Pre-register exact prompt templates, random seeds, retry policy, and the maximum model-call budget; enforce a paired-baseline design (same topology seeds for both methods).
Define and preregister simulator-derived operational-failure labels and mapping (e.g., reachability, ACL violations, routing convergence) plus validation/spot-checks against vendor behavior.
